source.author: verg
source.text: Incipe, parve puer, risu cognoscere matrem, matri longa decem tulerunt fastidia menses.
source.text_original: Incipe, parve puer, risu cognoscere matrem, / matri longa decem tulerunt fastidia menses.
source.text_english: Begin, little boy, to know your mother by her smile; your mother has borne ten long months of weariness for you.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: rapiat eam auia, patrem risibus recognoscat, sit omnibus amabilis et uniuersa propinquitas rosam ex se natam gaudeat.
reuse.text_original: rapiat eam auia, patrem risibus recognoscat, sit omnibus amabilis et uniuersa propinquitas rosam ex se natam gaudeat.
reuse.text_english: Let her be carried off by her grandmother, let her recognize her father by his laughter, let her be lovable to everyone, and let all her kin rejoice that a rose has been born from among them.
